spec.title: CBMC 6.11.0's source times Runtime Post-process inside Runtime Solver (resubmitted with a matching grep)
spec.description: Resubmission of job 20261106-192959-cbmc-6-11-0-s-source-times-runtime-post (finding VF-004), whose display grep '^decision_proceduret::resultt run_property_decider' matched nothing in CBMC 6.11.0's bmc_util.cpp, so under pipefail the step exited 1 before any check ran. This job prints run_property_decider with 'grep -n -B2 -A45 "run_property_decider("', and also the 'Runtime decision procedure' line(s) and the post_processing_done guard from both files; the display greps print '(no match)' instead of failing, so the step always reaches the checks. The three grep -q checks are unchanged: 'Runtime Solver' in bmc_util.cpp, 'Runtime Post-process' and 'finish_eager_conversion' in prop_conv_solver.cpp. Network fetch: downloads goto-checker/bmc_util.cpp and solvers/prop/prop_conv_solver.cpp at tag cbmc-6.11.0 from raw.githubusercontent.com. Purpose, from the original job: Phase 1a of llm-dlc/loops/engine-priorities.md reads JBMC's phases per solver call, on the claim that run_property_decider's 'Runtime Solver' times the whole call and that prop_conv_solvert::dec_solve, inside it, runs finish_eager_conversion and reports it as 'Runtime Post-process'; lib/src/phases.rs counts the post-processing under encoding alone and the rest of the call under solving. If a check fails, the printed code above it shows where the string actually lives.
spec.expected: Both files download; the log shows run_property_decider timing property_decider.solve() as 'Runtime Solver', the 'Runtime decision procedure' line, the post_processing_done guard, and dec_solve calling finish_eager_conversion() and printing 'Runtime Post-process'. Ends with 'all three strings found' and exits 0.

steps.name: fetch and show CBMC 6.11.0's solver timers
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; base=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diffblue/cbmc/cbmc-6.11.0/src; d=$(mktemp -d); curl -fsSL "$base/goto-checker/bmc_util.cpp" -o "$d/bmc_util.cpp"; curl -fsSL "$base/solvers/prop/prop_conv_solver.cpp" -o "$d/prop_conv_solver.cpp"; sha256sum "$d"/*.cpp; cd "$d"; echo "== bmc_util.cpp: run_property_decider"; { grep -n -B2 -A45 "run_property_decider(" bmc_util.cpp || echo "(no match)"; } | head -150; echo "== 'Runtime decision procedure' lines"; grep -n -H "Runtime decision procedure" bmc_util.cpp prop_conv_solver.cpp || echo "(no match)"; echo "== post_processing_done guard"; grep -n -H -B1 -A6 "post_processing_done" bmc_util.cpp prop_conv_solver.cpp || echo "(no match)"; echo "== prop_conv_solver.cpp: dec_solve"; { grep -n -A40 "prop_conv_solvert::dec_solve" prop_conv_solver.cpp || echo "(no match)"; } | head -60; echo "== checks"; grep -q "Runtime Solver" bmc_util.cpp; grep -q "Runtime Post-process" prop_conv_solver.cpp; grep -q "finish_eager_conversion" prop_conv_solver.cpp; echo "all three strings found"; cd /; rm -rf "$d"
